notes: Ministry groupings are read from each demand's own Notes on Demands, which prints the ministry as the heading above the demand number. The structure is the one the 2026-27 Budget publishes, applied to every period so a demand keeps one place across years; a machinery-of-government change that moved a demand between ministries in an earlier year is not reflected. Descriptions list the departments each ministry contains rather than characterising it. Official websites are recorded only where the site named itself as that body — its own page title, or its full name in the page — so a missing url means unverified, not absent. Nothing here is written from recollection: a plausible-looking domain that does not corroborate is dropped.
